Infleqtion has announced a new advancement in its fault‑tolerant quantum computing software, integrating components from NVIDIA’s CUDA‑Q logical framework. The update, highlighted on Business Wire, is designed to improve the scalability and reliability of quantum algorithms by leveraging GPU‑accelerated compilation techniques. This release underscores Infleqtion’s commitment to bridging classical and quantum computational capabilities.
